limitations: Community-maintained map assertions; not verified by Virginia Tech or Town of Blacksburg.
A lit=yes tag is not a measured light level, current operating status, maintained service guarantee, or safety assessment.
Missing objects or lit tags mean unknown; this is not a complete lamp inventory.
Last edit timestamps describe the OSM object, not necessarily a lighting survey or lighting-tag edit.
The wider bbox contains roads, bus stops, pedestrian paths and other objects. Lit tags on bus stops or buildings do not describe adjoining paths.
Closed ways explicitly tagged area=yes are normalized as Polygon; they are not route centerlines.
No route-wide illumination score or route coverage is asserted.
